title: ICPC location tree — locations.yaml
description: Where contests happen, as a tree: country > region (state/province, optional) > city > institution (university or venue). Each node has a globally unique slug id; contests point at nodes through sites[].location (DEFINITIONS.md, Locations). Cross-node rules (parent chains, type ordering, alias uniqueness) are checked by tools/validate.py.

locationId.description: slug: countries are the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in lowercase (us); everything below is <country>-<slug> (us-boulder, us-boulder-cu-boulder)

name.description: display name (the gazetteer's primary name for cities, the institution's own name)

parent.description: required on every node but a country; a region or city hangs under a country, a city may hang under a region, an institution hangs under a city

code.description: region only: the state/province postal code (US states, Canadian provinces, Australian states)

geonameid.description: city only: GeoNames id of the populated place, when the node was matched to the gazetteer

aliases.description: other spellings seen in the sources (CMS labels, sheet text); unique across all nodes
